items.heading: Adobo
details: Key ingredients: chicken or pork, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf
Marinate chicken or pork in soy sauce, vinegar and garlic.
Brown the meat, then add the marinade and bay leaf.
Simmer slowly until the meat is tender and the sauce reduces.
Serve over steamed rice with extra sauce spooned on top.

items.heading: Sinigang
details: Key ingredients: pork or shrimp, tamarind, vegetables
Simmer pork or shrimp with tamarind broth until sour and fragrant.
Add vegetables like radish, eggplant and water spinach.
Cook until the vegetables are tender and the broth is well balanced.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
